newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air Liquide sees growth in 97 and beyond.
newsitem.headline: Air Liquide sees growth in 97 and beyond.

text.p: Industrial gases group Air Liquide, unveiling a 4.2 percent rise in consolidated net income for 1996, said on Tuesday it expected further growth in its results in 1997 and beyond.
It said in a statement that accelerated investments, financed over three years from cash flow and a "moderate" increase in debt, would keep the group on a solid financial footing.

"The return on these investments, mostly linked to long-term contracts, and reinforced efforts towards achieving extra productivity, will contribute to a growth in results in 1997 and beyond," the company said.
